artwork_status: Approved regional artwork is now stored at campaign/maps/tallowmere_regional.png. Exact normalized coordinates remain pending visual calibration against the artwork.
coordinate_system: normalized 0-1; x from left, y from top; north up

authority.scale_warning: The printed 0-100 mile scale bar on the approved illustration is not a valid measurement reference. Preserve the established written travel distances and use the artwork for relative direction and terrain only.

markers.name: Tallowmere
markers.description: Walled port on the northwestern shore of the Inland Sea, at the mouth of the River Vale. House Denvor rules locally under a hereditary charter confirmed by House Kharadorn.

markers.name: Harthbridge
markers.description: Chartered market town and road junction on the South Road, governed under House Velleran's town charter and outside direct Denvor administration.

markers.name: Fordmere
markers.description: Upriver settlement at a dependable River Vale crossing, with a chartered crossing administered by House Merewick and a ferry supplement.

markers.name: Ashcombe Manor
markers.description: Fortified agricultural estate on Ashcombe Rise overlooking the Northfields and northern road. Held by House Avenholt under House Denvor.

markers.name: Millhaven
markers.description: Grain village and mill center on the River Vale, about 9 miles northwest of Tallowmere and a principal grain collection point for the city.

markers.name: Stonehollow
markers.description: Quarry settlement southwest of Tallowmere in the Greyback Ridges, supplying worked stone and quarry labor under established quarry charters.

markers.name: Brackenholt
markers.description: Woodland and charcoal settlement west of Tallowmere within the Brackenwood, supporting timber, charcoal, and managed woodland trades.

markers.name: Saltwick
markers.description: Working shore settlement southeast of Tallowmere with fishing, salt-working, preserved fish, net-making, and a modest navigational beacon. Superior jurisdiction remains unresolved.

geography.name: River Vale
geography.description: Principal inland route serving Tallowmere, descending from the western uplands through the farm country and into the harbor.

geography.name: Brackenwood
geography.description: Worked woodland west of Tallowmere supplying fuel, poles, timber, game, and gathered plants.

geography.name: Greyback Ridges
geography.description: Stony hills southwest of Tallowmere, with Stonehollow quarries on accessible eastern faces.

geography.name: Northfields
geography.description: Open agricultural country north and northeast of Tallowmere with farms, orchards, pasture, hedgerows, and drainage hollows.

geography.name: Eastern Shore
geography.description: Irregular shore southeast of Tallowmere with low bluffs, coves, beaches, fishing landings, and salt-working places.

routes.name: North Road
routes.description: Route from Tallowmere's North Gate through outer farms toward Ashcombe Manor and the Northfields.

routes.name: River Vale Road
routes.description: Western route following the River Vale through Millhaven toward Fordmere.

routes.name: Western Track
routes.description: Rough branch toward Brackenholt and the managed woodland, most reliable in dry conditions.

routes.name: Quarry Road
routes.description: Southwestern branch built for stone carts climbing toward Stonehollow and the Greyback Ridges.

routes.name: Eastern Shore Road
routes.description: Coastal route southeast to Saltwick and smaller shore landings.

routes.name: King's Road / South Road
routes.description: Southern route from Tallowmere toward Harthbridge and the fragmented southern jurisdictions.

landmarks.name: Old Stone Bridge
landmarks.description: Principal permanent river crossing within Tallowmere.

landmarks.name: Bellwater Pool
landmarks.description: Deep, slow pool on the River Vale upstream of Millhaven, used by bargemen as a waiting and turning place.

landmarks.name: Saltwick Beacon
landmarks.description: Modest shore beacon maintained by Saltwick boat-owning households as a navigation and storm-warning aid.

political_notes.house-denvor: Ruling house of Tallowmere and immediate lordship. Do not imply direct administration of every neighboring settlement.
political_notes.house-velleran: Holds Harthbridge under a town charter. Harthbridge is a commercial rival to Tallowmere, not automatically an enemy.
political_notes.house-merewick: Holds the hereditary charter for Fordmere crossing, ferry, and toll rights.
political_notes.house-avenholt: Holds Ashcombe Manor under House Denvor.
political_notes.saltwick: Local freeholders and shore charter; superior jurisdiction remains unresolved.
political_notes.house-relland: Minor house under House Velleran. Keep its historical crime and PC family connection GM-only.

import_safety.reason: This specification intentionally contains no x/y or polygon points. It is a structured content registry for the regional map and must not be fed to the live synchronizer until coordinates are placed against the approved artwork.
import_safety.next_cartographic_step: Visually calibrate the approved regional artwork, then convert these source records into a live atlas layer with reviewed marker and route coordinates.
